name: write-missing-test
instruction: slugify.js exports slugify(s) and works correctly, but it has no tests. Write slugify.test.js using node:test and node:assert that thoroughly covers it (lowercasing, trimming, replacing runs of punctuation/spaces with a single dash, no leading or trailing dashes). Do not change slugify.js. Run it with "node --test slugify.test.js".
